name: Pricing Page made with Shadcn UI
summary: Customizable shadcn/ui pricing page section for Next.js 14 with three plans, a monthly/yearly toggle and dark mode.
description: A pricing page section built from shadcn/ui components (card, tabs, dropdown-menu, button) for Next.js 14 projects. It shows three plan cards (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) with monthly and yearly pricing, automatically calculated yearly savings, optional Popular and Exclusive plan tags, and light, dark and system themes through next-themes.
contains: three plans: Basic, Pro and Enterprise with Popular and Exclusive tags
monthly and yearly pricing with savings calculated and highlighted
dark, light and system themes via next-themes
built from shadcn/ui card, tabs, dropdown-menu and button
Next.js 14 app with a live demo on Vercel
